svg.title: TerraDart — terradart_dev profile icon
svg.desc: The TerraDart descending-dart mark (branding/svg/mark-dark.svg geometry and lifted palette) on the inverted paper-dark ground. Scaled about the mark's area centroid so it sits inside a circular crop; the Terra stratum is thickened from 6 to 14 units so it survives at 48px.
